objects.name: Analytic 1857
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS)-role account authenticating via interactive or remote logon from a workstation not in the approved host inventory, or outside the account's established usage pattern, immediately followed within a short window by that session connecting to the field device network or ICS application. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: IP ranges from which SSH administrative access to ICS Linux assets is authorized.
Inventory of workstations/jump hosts from which ICS-role accounts are authorized to authenticate.
IP ranges from which network device administrative access is authorized.
Time window after anomalous logon within which device-subnet connection is considered correlated, typically 5-15 minutes.
Naming convention or group-membership pattern identifying accounts with engineering, operator, or ICS service roles.
Defined normal working hours for interactive ICS engineering activity, widened for 24/7 shift-based operations.
